description: This Java source file defines the class 'MappingAndDelegatingCommandConsumer', which extends 'CommandConsumer'. It encapsulates the logic for creating and managing a command consumer that interacts with an AMQP receiver link, specifically for consuming commands on a tenant-scoped address within the Hono client implementation.
